INVALID_COLOUR: Pick a colour from the colour box.
INVALID_BEAN_CODE: Short code: 2 to 6 letters or numbers, nothing else.
BEAN_CODE_TAKEN: Another bean already uses that short code (or it is a reserved word like MIX or RAW).
COFFEE_STILL_RESTING: This coffee is still resting. Tick that the customer agreed, or wait until it's ready.
BAD_BOSS: Choose an active person other than themselves.
HIERARCHY_LOOP: That would make a loop: this person is already above the boss you chose.
INVALID_EMAIL: That email address doesn't look right.
INSIGHTS_LOCKED: Enter the cash-view PIN to open this.
INSIGHTS_PIN_NOT_SET: No cash-view PIN yet. Set one first.
BEAN_TYPE_REQUIRED: Say which beans the customer brought.
END_READING_BELOW_START: The end reading can't be lower than the start reading.
TICKET_TITLE_REQUIRED: Say in a few words what is wrong.
INVALID_TICKET: Choose the machine/area and how urgent it is.
SAY_WHAT_WAS_DONE: Write what was done to fix it.
VOICE_NOT_IN_PREVIEW: Voice notes work in the installed portal, not in this preview.
ABOVE_YOUR_APPROVAL_LIMIT: This is above your approval limit. An admin must approve it.
ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone has already decided this. Refresh the page.
ALREADY_ROASTED: This customer job is already roasted.
BAD_ASSIGNEE: That person can't be given work (account switched off?).
BILL_NEEDS_ITEMS: Add at least one item to the bill.
BLEND_NEEDS_INPUTS: Choose the lots for each part of the blend.
BOOKING_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Enter the Rapido / Uber booking reference.
CANNOT_APPROVE_OWN_REQUEST: You can't approve your own request. Someone else must approve it.
CANNOT_CANCEL_AFTER_DISPATCH: Part of this order has already gone out, so it can't be cancelled.
CANNOT_MESSAGE_THIS_PERSON: You can message your managers. Ask the admin if you need to reach someone else.
CHICORY_PRODUCT_REQUIRED: Choose which chicory stock this blend takes from.
CHOOSE_THE_RAW_COFFEE: Choose which raw coffee the customer wants.
COMPONENT_NAME_REQUIRED: Give every part of the recipe a name.
CORRECTION_WOULD_GO_NEGATIVE: That correction would take the lot below zero.
COUNT_ALREADY_PENDING: A count for this lot is already waiting for approval.
COUNT_THE_PACKS: Enter how many good (and rejected) packs you made.
DELIVERED_MORE_THAN_SENT: Delivered kg can't be more than what was sent.
DISCOUNTS_NOT_SET_UP: Discounts aren't set up. The admin sets the cap in Admin Control → Settings.
DISCOUNT_ABOVE_CAP: That discount is above the allowed limit.
DISCOUNT_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for the discount.
DISPATCH_BLOCKED_CREDIT: Can't dispatch yet: credit for this order isn't approved.
DISPATCH_BLOCKED_PAYMENT: Can't dispatch yet: payment hasn't been received. Record the payment in Outgoing Sales first.
DUPLICATE_INPUT_LOT: The same lot is chosen twice. Pick two different lots.
EVERY_COMPONENT_NEEDS_A_LOT: Every part of the recipe needs a lot and kg.
EXPLAIN_THE_DIFFERENCE: The cash doesn't match. Write a short note explaining the difference.
FILE_DATA_INVALID: That file couldn't be read. Try again.
FILE_EXPIRED_OR_MISSING: That file is no longer available.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large (max 8 MB).
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP files can be attached.
INPUT_KG_NEEDS_3_DECIMAL_PRECISION: Use up to 3 decimal places for kg.
INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough free stock in that lot.
ITEM_NOT_ON_PRICE_LIST: That item is no longer on the price list. Refresh the page.
KG_NEEDS_3_DECIMAL_PRECISION: Use up to 3 decimal places for kg.
LOT_CANNOT_BE_CORRECTED: This lot can't be corrected in its current state.
LOT_NOT_ALLOCATABLE: That lot can't be used (on hold, rejected or not ours).
LOT_NOT_FOUND: No lot has that code. Check the label or type it again.
LOT_WRONG_LOCATION: That lot isn't at production. Use stock that is at PROD-01.
LOT_WRONG_STAGE: That lot is the wrong type for this step.
MORE_THAN_DUE: That's more than the amount still due.
MORE_THAN_ORDERED: That's more than is left to send on this order.
NOTHING_NEW_TO_EXPORT: Nothing new to export for these dates — everything is already in an earlier export.
NOTHING_PACKED_YET: Nothing has been packed on this ticket yet.
NOTHING_TO_RETURN: Nothing is left to return to this customer.
NOT_ENOUGH_AT_COUNTER: Not enough stock at the counter. Ask production to send more.
NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK_TO_RESERVE: Not enough stock to reserve this order yet.
NOT_FOUND: That record wasn't found. Refresh the page.
NOT_WAITING_FOR_CREDIT: This order isn't waiting for a credit decision.
OPENING_CASH_NOT_SET: Opening cash isn't set. The admin sets it in Admin Control → Settings → Business values.
ORDER_ALREADY_DISPATCHED: This order has already gone out.
ORDER_NOT_READY: This order isn't ready: stock must be reserved first.
ORDER_NOT_WAITING_FOR_STOCK: This order isn't waiting for stock.
PACKED_MORE_THAN_COFFEE_USED: The packs weigh more than the coffee used. Check the numbers.
PAYMENT_MUST_EQUAL_TOTAL: Payments must add up exactly to the bill total.
RECEIPT_STOCK_ALREADY_USED: Some of this receipt's stock is already used, so it can't be reversed. Use a stock correction instead.
RECEIVED_MORE_THAN_SENT: Received kg can't be more than what was sent.
RECIPE_MUST_TOTAL_100: Recipe percentages must add up to 100.
RECIPE_NOT_FOUND: That recipe is switched off or missing.
REFUND_MORE_THAN_BILL: That's more than is left to refund on this bill.
RESERVED_STOCK_SHORT: Reserved stock is short. Check the lots for this order.
ROAST_FIRST: Roast the customer's coffee before recording payment.
SENDER_CANNOT_RECEIVE: The person who sent it can't receive it. Someone at the counter must confirm.
STOCK_PRODUCT_REQUIRED: Choose which stock item this counter item takes from.
TEAM_EXISTS: A team with that name already exists.
USE_SUPPLIER_PAYMENTS: Record payments under Finance → Supplier payables.
USE_THE_SAME_SOURCE_LOT: Use the same coffee lot as the earlier runs on this ticket.
VOICE_DATA_INVALID: That voice note couldn't be read. Record again.
VOICE_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED: This phone's voice format isn't supported. Type the message instead.
VOICE_NOTE_TOO_LONG: Voice notes can be up to about 2 minutes.
PARTIAL_KG_REQUIRED: Weigh the partial bags together and enter their kg.
PARTIAL_KG_MUST_BE_LESS_THAN_FULL_BAGS: Partial bags must weigh less than the same number of full bags.
ROAST_NEEDS_1_OR_2_INPUTS: A batch uses one or two coffee lots.
CHOOSE_A_ROAST_PROFILE: Choose a roast profile from the list.
ROAST_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: That roast profile was switched off. Choose another.
APPROVE_THE_DRAFT_FIRST: Approve the draft before switching it on or off.
INVALID_CATEGORY: Choose a type for this product.
CHOOSE_WHO_DOES_IT: Linked work needs a person — choose who does it.
ASSIGNEE_CANNOT_DO_THIS_WORK: This person isn't allowed to do that work. Give them the permission first, or choose someone else.
INVALID_LINK: That packing ticket or order no longer exists.
TASK_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: This work is already marked completed and waiting for review.
ONLY_THE_ASSIGNED_PERSON_CAN_COMPLETE: Only the person doing the work can mark it completed.
EXPLAIN_WHY_TARGET_NOT_REACHED: The target isn't reached yet. Add a note saying why it's complete.
NO_ONE_CAN_REVIEW_THIS: Nobody else can review this yet. Ask the admin to give a manager the review permission.
NOT_WAITING_FOR_REVIEW: This work isn't waiting for review.
ONLY_THE_ASSIGNER_REVIEWS_THIS: Only the person who assigned this work can approve it.
COUNTER_CLOSED_FOR_TODAY: Today's bills are closed. The counter opens again tomorrow (an admin can reopen it).
CUSTOM_BLEND_NOT_SET_UP: Custom blends aren't set up. The admin sets coffee and chicory rates in Admin Control → Prices.
INVALID_COFFEE_PCT: Coffee % must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
PRICE_CHANGE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for changing the price.
ONLY_TODAY_CAN_BE_REOPENED: Only today's counter can be reopened.
NETWORK_DOWN: Can't reach the portal. Check the Wi-Fi and try again — nothing was saved.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That sign-in didn't match. Check and try again.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED_TRY_LATER: Too many wrong tries. This account is paused for 10 minutes, or ask an admin to reset it.
SESSION_EXPIRED: You were signed out. Please sign in again.
SESSION_IDLE: You were signed out because the device was idle.
ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been switched off by an admin.
ACCESS_DENIED: You don't have access to do this. Ask your admin if you need it.
MUST_CHANGE_SECRET: Please set your own password first.
CURRENT_SECRET_WRONG: Your current password/PIN is not correct.
UNKNOWN_BEAN: No bean or product with that name. Add it on the Beans & products sheet (same spelling).
UNKNOWN_CLIENT: No client with that name. Add it on the Clients sheet (same spelling).
UNKNOWN_SUPPLIER: No supplier with that name. Add it on the Suppliers sheet (same spelling).
UNKNOWN_STAFF: No staff member with that name. Use the name exactly as in People.
INVALID_FORM: Form must be Raw, Roasted or Ground.
INVALID_BAG_CONDITION: Bag condition must be Sound, Partial or Damaged.
INVALID_BAGS: Bags must be a whole number.
INVALID_KG: Kg must be a number above 0.
INVALID_PLACE: Place must be Production or Counter.
INVALID_DUE_TYPE: Type must be Client owes us, We owe supplier or Staff advance.
ROAST_DATE_REQUIRED: Roasted and ground coffee needs its roast date.
ALREADY_LIVE: You're already live: opening stock and old dues are locked. Use Count / Correct and Finance instead.
ONLY_OWNER_CONFIRMS: Only the owner can press We're live.
NOT_AN_EXCEL_FILE: That isn't an Excel (.xlsx) file. In Excel use Save As → Excel Workbook.
IN_INSTALLED_PORTAL_ONLY: This works in the installed portal, not in this preview.
FILE_EMPTY: That file looks empty. Choose the scan or photo again.
SECRETS_DONT_MATCH: The two new entries are not the same. Type them again.
INVALID_VOICE_SPEED: Choose one of the read-aloud speeds.
PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: Password needs at least 10 characters with letters and numbers.
PIN_TOO_SIMPLE: That PIN is too easy to guess (like 1111 or 1234). Choose another.
PIN_ONLY_FOR_STAFF_LEVEL: PIN sign-in is only for staff-level roles. Managers and admins use a password.
OWNER_IS_PROTECTED: The owner account is protected and cannot be changed by anyone else.
ONLY_OWNER_CAN_CHANGE_ADMINS: Only the owner can change this.
CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ACCESS: You can't change your own access. Another admin (or the owner) must do it.
CANNOT_GIVE_ACCESS_YOU_DO_NOT_HAVE: You can only give access that you have yourself.
ADMIN_ONLY_PERMISSION: That permission can only belong to admin-level roles.
ADMIN_ROLE_IS_LOCKED: The Admin role always has full access and can't be edited.
ROLE_STILL_HAS_PEOPLE: Move everyone out of this role before switching it off.
SYSTEM_ROLE_CANNOT_BE_DISABLED: Built-in roles can't be switched off.
ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: A role with that name already exists.
USERNAME_LETTERS_NUMBERS_ONLY: Username: small letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore only.
REASON_REQUIRED: Please write a short reason (at least 5 characters).
EXPIRY_MUST_BE_IN_FUTURE: The end time must be in the future.
DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_MUST_BE_ENABLED: The default language must be one of the switched-on languages.
PRODUCT_NOMINAL_KG_NOT_CONFIGURED: This product has no approved kg-per-bag yet. Ask the admin to set it in Master Data.
DAMAGED_EXCEEDS_BAGS: Damaged bags can't be more than total bags.
RAW_LOT_NOT_ALLOCATABLE: That lot can't be roasted (on hold, quarantined or not company stock).
INSUFFICIENT_RAW_STOCK: Not enough coffee left in that lot. Ask your manager to check.
OUTPUT_EXCEEDS_INPUT_OR_ZERO: Roasted output must be more than zero and not more than the input.
QC_ALREADY_DECIDED: This batch already has a quality decision.
QC_DECISION_AND_NOTE_REQUIRED: Please write a reason (at least 5 characters).
VERIFIED_EXCEEDS_NOMINAL: Verified kg can't be more than the recorded kg.
PROGRESS_EXCEEDS_TARGET: Progress can't be more than the target.
PACK_COUNT_EXCEEDS_TARGET: Packs done can't be more than the target.
BAD_REQUEST_ORIGIN: Request blocked for safety. Reload the page and try again.
